summary: Revised artifact retention from conservative review recommendations to deterministic keep/drop/organize decisions using the repo's living versus point-in-time rubric. Raw and normalized artifacts are point-in-time evidence and default to commit; bulk extraction packets are regenerable working output and default to delete; real extracted JSON, source-grounded briefs, and belief files default to commit; degraded run diagnostics default to attach-to-issue; SQLite remains local. Evidence: app/artifacts.py, AGENTS.md, docs/living/project/processes/artifact-commit-policy.md, docs/living/project/processes/documentation-model.md, tests/test_artifact_retention.py, uv run aic artifact-report --json, and uv run pytest -> 50 passed.
